name: Overhead Press (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand or sit with dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Press the weights overhead until your arms are straight, without shrugging.
Keep the core braced and ribs down — don't lean back.
Lower slowly to shoulder height. Dumbbells allow a natural range of motion.
longevityNotes: Pressing keeps shoulders useful, but joint-friendly volume beats grinding maxes. Full range, controlled tempo, and balanced pulling keep the shoulders healthy for decades.
overview: A beginner dumbbell press-pattern exercise targeting the front delts. Overhead Press (Dumbbell) builds the upper-body pushing strength used in everything from getting off the floor to overhead reaching.
